outline: This course will introduce the numerical, statistical, and computational methods in engineering analysis, including following topics: Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems; Numerical Methods and Computational Mechanics; Statical Analysis Methods; and Machine Learning Methods.
schedule:
1	Course Introduction
2	Mathematical Fundamentals and Notation
3	Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems (I)
4	Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems (II)
5	Numerical Methods and Computational Mechanics (I)
6	Numerical Methods and Computational Mechanics (II)
7	No lecture (Compensatory holiday for Tomb Sweeping Day)
8	Probability Theory in Data Analysis
9	Mid-term exam
10	Statical Analysis Methods (I)
11	Statical Analysis Methods (II)
12	Statistical Analysis Software
13	Data Presentation
14	In-class exercise
15	Classification and Clustering Analysis
16	Machine Learning Methods (I)
17	Machine Learning Methods (II)
18	Final exam
assessment:
Subject Mark =
Attendance 20% +
Mid-term exam 25% +
In-class exercise 20% +
Final exam 35%
